title: Current S3S board.
text: These are the people keeping S3S moving this year.

items.name: Amy Maciel
items.description: Keeps the board organized, chairs meetings, and serves as the main S3S contact for RCID and RSA.

items.name: Janis Palma
items.description: Helps plan S3S events and keeps the board connected to what members need.

items.role: Vice President for Online Student Affairs
items.name: Kieran Helbling
items.description: Brings online student concerns to the board and helps make S3S events and resources easier to access from a distance.

items.name: Rose Ebrahimi
items.description: Keeps minutes, records, and budget notes in order.

items.name: Open
items.description: Helps save the materials, records, and event traces S3S will need later.

items.name: Frederick Sunkpa
items.description: Handles the website, social media, and public-facing updates.

items.name: Durga Bhusal
items.description: Helps incoming students find people, places, and resources during the first year.

items.name: Open
items.description: Represents RCID student concerns in Graduate Student Government once the seat is filled.
